name: shader-background
title: Shader Background
description: A soft, flowing noise field drawn by a raw WebGL shader in your theme colors. Sleeps off screen, falls back to a CSS gradient.

props.name: speed
props.description: Speed multiplier. 0 holds the field still.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Strength of the color field, from 0 (plain background) to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
